body:
## Summary
- Import LTAIP full macro-packet series into the repo: TP-LTAIP-H0-001..008 and TP-LTAIP-POST-009..012 (JSON + companion MD).
- Add Task Orchestrator load-plan artifacts under `docs/ops/load-plans/` (canonical plan, REST epics payload, task tree, v3 advisory, load instructions).
- Add dry-run/apply loader `scripts/leantime-ai-parity/load_task_orchestrator.py`, REST epics schema, and payload unit test.

## Scope / non-goals
- **Does not** execute any task packet.
- **Does not** perform a live Task Orchestrator write (`live_task_orchestrator_load: PENDING_LOAD`; apply requires explicit `--approve LTAIP_TASK_ORCHESTRATOR_LOAD`).
- Filename hygiene: overlay `LTAIP-H0-LOAD-INSTRUCTIONS.md` renamed to `ltaip-h0-load-instructions.md`.

## Validation
- jsonschema validate: 12/12 packets against `docs/03-reference/spec/dopetask/dopetask-canonical-spec.json`
- `python -m json.tool` on load plan + epics payload
- `load_task_orchestrator.py --dry-run` → 13 entries (root + 12 epics), no network write
- `pytest -q tests/prototypes/leantime-ai-parity/test_task_orchestrator_load_payload.py`
- docs hygiene / filename hygiene / root hygiene on imported paths
- `git diff --check`

## Test plan
- [x] Schema-validate all `task-packets/leantime-ai-parity/*.json`
- [x] Dry-run loader against `task_orchestrator_epics-LTAIP-H0.json`
- [x] Unit test for load payload
- [ ] (separate authorization) live TO load with `--approve LTAIP_TASK_ORCHESTRATOR_LOAD` only after operator gate

## Source
- Overlay: `LTAIP-FULL-MACROPACKETS-001/repo-overlay`
- Worktree: `dopemux-mvp-wt-LTAIP-PACKET-IMPORT` branch `docs/ltaip-full-packet-import`
